Let me run review_patch once more without fault_covered to confirm clean before proposing.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_rqODSbzAWGPaGBuNTmBc1242","type":"function","function":{"name":"zts_expert_review_patch","arguments":"{"content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\n\nstructural OrderProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"retry_safe\"\n  | \"idempotent\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing idempotency-key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const reservation = step(\"reserve\", () => ({ reservationId: \"res-1\" }));\n    const charge = step(\"charge\", () => ({ chargeId: \"chg-1\" }));\n    return Response.json(\n      {\n        reserved: reservation.reservationId !== \"\",\n        charged: charge.chargeId !== \"\",\n      },\n      { status: 201 }\n    );\n  });\n}\n", "file": "handler.ts"}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":28368,"completion_tokens":702,"total_tokens":29070,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":28160},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":366},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":28160,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":208},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
